data.notes: Confirmed December 2026 Lagos music programming is still rolling out, but the verified calendar already centers on Detty December festivals, Flytime’s Eko Convention Centre run, beach raves, and diaspora-led nightlife.

events.title: Detty December Fest 2026
events.venueName: Detty December Village / Detty Festival Stage
events.summary: Livespot’s 13-day Detty December Fest calendar runs across Lagos from 18–30 December, with multiple concerts, parties and experience nights; the confirmed season highlight is Wizkid opening the festival on 18 December.

events.title: Detty December Fest Grand Opening Concert ft. Wizkid
events.summary: Wizkid headlines the opening night of Detty December Fest, with DOT TIX listing the show for 18 December 2026 at Detty December Village, Lagos.

events.title: Flytime Fest, Powered by Coca-Cola
events.summary: Flytime Promotions confirms Flytime Fest, Powered by Coca-Cola, for 22–24 December 2026 at Eko Convention Centre as the central three-night festival block in its December Lagos series.

events.title: Coca-Cola Rhythm Unplugged 2026
events.summary: Flytime Promotions lists Coca-Cola Rhythm Unplugged for 21 December 2026 as part of its six-night December run at Eko Convention Centre; lineup details were still to be announced in the source.

events.title: Flytime’s House of RnB: The Concert — Brandy
events.summary: Flytime Promotions confirms Brandy as headliner for Flytime’s House of RnB at Eko Hotel Conference Centre / Eko Convention Centre on 20 December 2026.

events.title: Dance Èkó 2026
events.summary: Two-day Lagos dance-music festival with Day 1 focused on underground/house sounds curated by Monochroma and Day 2 on amapiano/afropiano curated by Even In The Day.

events.title: Roadblock — Rave Apocalypse: The Awakening
events.venueName: Balmoral Convention Centre, Federal Palace Hotel
events.summary: Large-scale Afro-electronic Roadblock rave at Balmoral/Federal Palace, combining DJs, live-orchestra elements, show production and all-white/all-black dress code.

events.title: ABE Lagos 2026
events.summary: All Black Everything’s Christmas-night Lagos diaspora party, selling general entry and VIP tables and billed around Afrobeats, old-school sounds and amapiano.

events.title: Detty December Beach Rave
events.summary: Christmas-night beachfront rave at Voda Beach Club with three stages spanning Afrobeats/amapiano, deep house/lo-fi and bass-focused sounds, capped at 3,000 capacity.

events.title: Eko Beach Rave & X Festival
events.summary: Rayda Entertainment’s beach rave at Voda Beach, billed around Afrobeats, amapiano and afrohouse with a coastal electronic/festival setup and paid access tickets.

events.title: Flytime Circle
events.summary: Flytime Promotions lists 25 December 2026 for Flytime Circle, described by the organiser as a new concert franchise closing its six-night Eko Convention Centre run.

events.title: ELITE FEST 2026
events.venueName: Balmoral Convention Centre, Federal Palace Hotel
events.summary: ELITE FEST 2026 is listed as a one-day Afrobeats festival at Balmoral Convention Centre, Victoria Island, with doors at 4:00 PM WAT.

events.title: Mádé Kuti at the Beach 2
events.summary: Mádé Kuti & The Movement perform an intimate beachside live set at Jara Beach Resort with DJs, food, drinks and optional return bus transport from Ikoyi.

events.title: OFF-DUTY by Onchain Festival
events.summary: A two-day tech-rave positioned as an all-white, after-hours culture event with silent disco programming, main-stage moments, an Off Duty Rave and a headline act slot.

events.title: The Goddess Afrobeats Portal
events.summary: A small-format curated Afrobeats BYOB night at Ivy Bar Restaurant, centered on music, movement, lounging and dancefloor energy curated by High Priestess.

events.title: FESTAC@50
events.venueName: Multiple venues across Lagos: National Theatre, Tafawa Balewa Square, J. Randle Centre and Amuwo-Odofin
events.summary: Published programme materials list FESTAC@50 as a multi-venue Pan-African cultural festival running across Lagos from 26 December 2026 to 2 January 2027. Listed programme strands include the Opening Declaration, Pan-African Cultural & Creative Expo, FESTAC Dialogues, and the Unity Concert & Grand Closing Ceremony.
